caption: This drawing depicts a symmetrical composition featuring a large yellow cross with a gray base at the center, outlined in black and scalloped lines. The cross is set against a background of light peach or pink, with the area inside the cross itself left mostly uncolored except for the gray base. At the top, a draped curtain in a dark red or maroon color with black trim and yellow-gold accents frames the upper part of the cross, with decorative swags and circular details on either side. On both the left and right sides of the drawing, there are vertical areas filled with rectangular and curved patterns in shades of yellow, brown, blue, and black. Below the arms of the cross, the background is adorned with a grid of blue and red squares, each marked with an "X" in the center, and bordered by dotted and dashed lines. In the bottom corners, triangle shapes are filled with decorative motifs in black, red, and yellow, surrounded by more "X"-marked squares and diagonal lines. The entire drawing is framed with a thick black border.
title: Plate 13: Design with Cross, Chimayo: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
